314:                 &&& start <= end
315:                 // we've read the tail, but the tail may have moved

325:                 // the start must be our local tail
326:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] == start
327:                 // the start must be before the end, can be equial if ltail == tail
328:                 &&& start <= end

353:             CombinerState::Reading(_) => true, // see reader_state_valid instead
354:             CombinerState::AdvancingHead{idx, min_local_version} => {

357:                 // forall replicas we'e seen, min_local_version is smaller than all localTails
358:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < idx ==> min_local_version <= self.local_versions[n])

361:                 // the observed head is smaller than all local tails
362:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < self.num_replicas as nat ==> observed_head <= self.local_versions[n])

364:             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail} => {
365:                 // the current index is between local tails and tail.
366:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] <= cur_idx <= tail
367:                 // the read tail is smaller or equal to the current tail.
368:                 &&& tail <= self.tail

370:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= cur_idx <= (self.tail as int)

372:                 &&& (forall |i : nat| cur_idx <= i < tail ==> (

416:         reader_start(node_id: NodeId) {
417:             have   local_versions    >= [ node_id => let local_head ];

464:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })

474:         reader_unguard(node_id: NodeId) {
475:             remove combiner -= [
476:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })

497:     }

pub open spec fn map_min_value(m: Map<NodeId, nat>, idx: nat) -> nat
